# Kickoff Handoff Template

The `kickoff` handoff between the seats ([development §2](../../../safechord.kdd.practice.development.md#handoffs-between-the-seats)), written by the Settler once, before dispatch. It is the [handoff template](../handoff.md) as it is; what it holds is narrowed here.

- It names the Done When items the Settler has already completed, so that the Pioneer neither redoes them nor raises them again.
- It hands over constraints and risks, not a mechanism: a case nobody has tried is written as a risk, never as a design to follow.
